question: The Government of India and NITI Aayog launched the ‘Transformation of Aspirational Districts’ initiative with a vision to improve India's ranking under the Human Development Index by 2022. Which of the following is NOT one of the program's core areas of focus?
solution:
__**Industry and innovation**__ is NOT correct.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aspirational District Program -**

 
 
• It was** launched by the Prime Minister **in** January 2018.**
 
• Its objective is to improve the** socio-economic indicators** of 112 less developed districts of the country.
 
• This is an important initiative for the guiding principle of '**Yeh Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas, and Sabka Vishwas'.**
 
• **NITI Aayog** is the nodal agency for running this program.
 
• ADP is based on 49 indicators from the 5 identified thematic areas, which focus closely on improving people’s **Health & Nutrition, Education, Agriculture & Water Resources, Financial Inclusion & Skill Development, and Basic Infrastructure**__.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **​Human Development Index (HDI) -**

 
 
• This index includes **indicators of life expectancy, access to education or knowledge**, and income or standard of living.
 
• It presents important data on the** level of quality of life and changes** in it.
 
• This index is a contribution of two famous economists** 'Mehboob-ul-Haq' (Pakistan) and Amartya Sen (India).**
